summary: Iteration 26 (frontend-only) verified NO REGRESSIONS after (a) NotesApp.jsx refactor extracting AppHeader.jsx (~113 lines) + AppSearchBar.jsx and (b) IS_NATIVE dual-path additions in BarcodeScannerModal.jsx and utils/haptic.js. All 12 header testids render correctly (header-quick-add, header-tile-packs, header-calendar, header-language, header-insights, header-kid-mode, header-meal-planner, header-pantry, header-barcode, header-trip-journal, archive-trash-btn, settings-btn); header-shopping-mode correctly hidden when no active grocery note exists. All 6 AppSearchBar testids render and function (search-input, view-mode-toggle, view-mode-list, view-mode-icon, group-toggle, select-mode-toggle). Barcode modal: opens correctly on web, shows graceful 'Camera scan not supported' fallback (BarcodeDetector unavailable in Playwright chromium — confirms IS_NATIVE=false short-circuits ML Kit dynamic import as expected). Manual entry end-to-end works: typed '3017620422003' → Look Up → Nutella/Ferrero product renders with nutrition (539 kcal/100g, fat 30.9g, etc.) → 'Add to list' → toast 'New Shopping List created with Nutella' → new Grocery-tagged note appears in list (notes count 4 → 5). FAB add-note opens NoteModal. Zero console errors captured, zero page errors. Haptic util imports @capacitor/core cleanly on web without invoking @capacitor/haptics (dynamic import gated by IS_NATIVE).
critical_code_review_comments: AppHeader.jsx and AppSearchBar.jsx are clean pure/dumb components — good separation of concerns, all handlers passed as props, all data-testids preserved.

BarcodeScannerModal.jsx correctly gates ML Kit via dynamic `await import('@capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning')` only inside IS_NATIVE branches; web bundle is unaffected. Verified in-browser: no attempt to load the ML Kit module on web.

utils/haptic.js: dynamic import of @capacitor/haptics is properly deferred behind IS_NATIVE guard — no web-side side effects. Static import of @capacitor/core is safe (core exposes Capacitor.isNativePlatform on web as a no-op returning false).

Minor (pre-existing, from iter 25): PantryModal Unit Select has a React key warning; TripJournalModal has a nested <button> hydration warning. Neither surfaced in this iteration's flows and both remain LOW priority.
NotesApp.jsx reduced from 1917 → 1802 lines; further slicing opportunities remain (e.g., extract the modal-mount block into <AppModals /> and the note-list block into <NoteListView />).
seed_data_creation: None required — app auto-restored 4 seed notes from server. Tour dismissed via 'Skip' button; a 'grocery Shopping List' note was created organically by the Add-to-list test.
